news.t04: I am reading the news… where did you see it?
news.article: Earlier today an anonymous human was found to have eaten the cat’s treats, and the nation is reeling. A spokescat condemned the act, saying “the human we trusted stabbed us in the back”. The human replied only, “it just looked so good…”, and trailed off. A dog from the next street, hearing the news, gave a dry “I knew it”. Experts expect the affair to send lasting ripples through the trust between pets and the people they live with.
